claim: The retained evidence map contains 97 unique included scholarly works with one-to-one bibliography, extraction, source-location, provenance, and publication-status records.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Checks exact key binding and nonblank required fields; does not independently validate source interpretation.

claim: The corpus contains 34 Android-artifact, 17 TPL, 17 supply-chain, 8 AI-mediated, and 21 review/method records.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Strata are protocol categories, not estimates of field prevalence.

claim: The corpus contains 76 primary/empirical/system records, including 74 with venue publication evidence, plus 21 review/method records; 93 works are venue-recorded overall.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Three active preprints and one technical method report remain explicitly typed; venue records do not imply full-text interpretation.

claim: Every retained record has a populated claim-level row; 87 records have current content checks (75 selected and 12 complete scoped).
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Row completeness is not source verification; 10 legacy rows remain not reverified. Two complete-scoped labels are inherited body-only checks. Scope and locators remain separate.

claim: The 21-record review matrix has 90 unresolved cells; direct all-dimension coverage is undetermined.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: 52 located 1/P cells and five scoped absences; 17 content-checked records including four method records with unresolved coverage, plus four unchecked records. TPL component authorization and stage limits are partial antecedents. No absence of an all-dimension predecessor is established.

claim: The cumulative dated recheck ledger contains 90 entries; the current content ledger checks 87 works.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Three recheck entries retain historical or non-paper readings; independent=false. Do not equate cumulative Q rows with newly read fulltexts.

claim: The retained historical manuscript citation audit binds all 97 bibliography entries with no duplicate, missing or uncited keys.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Citation consistency is distinct from entailment; unchecked records are cited as inventory entries, not technical support. This retained historical packaging audit does not add source readings or alter historical reading dates.

claim: Seven claim levels separate identity, composition, resemblance, derivation, process provenance, authorization, and behavioral assurance.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Claim discipline, not a complete lattice or universal theorem.

claim: Artifact resemblance alone does not uniquely establish derivation direction.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Direction may come from chronology, source, ownership, or authenticated process evidence.

claim: Component presence is distinct from application ancestry, exact version, reachability, and exploitability.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Forks, partial inclusion, database scope, and execution environment remain explicit.

claim: Authenticated provenance alone does not establish unrestricted benign behavior.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Trusted inspections or rebuilders support their actually configured properties under stated key/threshold/execution assumptions; metadata alone does not supply them.

claim: A valid signature does not automatically establish authorization under the relevant policy.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Role, scope, validity interval, revocation, and policy version remain necessary.

claim: Reproducible bytes do not establish approved inputs or acceptable behavior.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Reproducibility supports equality under declared inputs.

claim: A generation log need not be a complete causal history; this is an analytical requirement, not a measured universal failure.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Checked source steps and coarse snapshot limits motivate the counter-history; hidden contexts and sibling histories are not all empirical findings in the cited studies.

claim: Cross-layer assurance requires object, predecessor, principal, time, and policy bindings to the same digest or documented relation.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: No evidence layer is treated as a numerical substitute for another.

claim: The retained historical artifact-only delivery mirrors the genuine sibling paper build's 36-page PDF under the unchanged manuscript,screen,review template; its bytes and actual final engine log bind to the retained historical source.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: The owned paper driver executed all five compiler commands successfully. The snapshot PDF and actual final engine log are byte-identical mirrors, not a separate compile. Unavailable Windows child CPU/RSS measurements remain null. These checks establish build consistency, not source entailment, visual approval or official CSUR certification.

claim: Legacy depth labels are 61 full-or-selected-source and 36 abstract-or-selected-source; current content checks cover 87 records.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Ten legacy records are not content-reverified. Neither a DOI nor a legacy depth category certifies a read passage; selected and complete scoped readings are distinguished.

claim: The work is a bounded structured evidence synthesis, not a PRISMA-complete review, prevalence meta-analysis, or independent dual-coded study.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: No complete search-hit denominator or agreement statistic is claimed.

claim: The retained historical gap-pilot has 98 cells with conservative unknown handling and a same-process 21-cell recheck.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Historical bookkeeping pilot; no longer controls manuscript positioning.

claim: All 19,683 ternary 3x3 matrices agree with a separate completion oracle over 262,144 completion visits.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Validates finite bookkeeping semantics only.

claim: The current offline suite runs the discovered unit and mutation tests; execution is separately recorded.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Passing tests check supplied ledgers and bookkeeping, not source entailment, gap closure or scientific readiness. Historical raw runs are not current execution evidence.

claim: All 97 retained records have direct scholarly locators, one source-location row, one retained-record provenance row, and one publication-status row; no source-locator placeholder remains.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: The provenance map is explicitly retrospective and does not reconstruct a complete database-search hit denominator.

claim: Named retired observation templates are absent; that lexical property does not certify the remaining source interpretations.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Specific-sounding paraphrases and nonblank locators are insufficient; only explicitly checked fulltext rows carry current content-check status.

claim: Publication-status quarantine binds all 97 active records one-to-one, requires title/year agreement with BibTeX, canonicalizes 82 DOI records, and keeps one withdrawn work only in the exclusion ledger.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Record-level locator/version checking is not a comprehensive retraction-registry search; withdrawn and retracted statuses are rejected from the active corpus.

claim: The retained historical paper driver retains citation, overfull-box and template/font guards and enforces an internal upper bound of 36 pages; it creates only build/main.pdf.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: The internal budget is not a filler target or official CSUR submission limit. Unassigned publication furniture settings and inherited template warnings remain unchanged; no scientific or venue-readiness closure is claimed.

claim: The retained historical 36-page PDF received supplied layout inspection of all full-size pages at 108 dpi and six contact grids; actual pdffonts checking confirmed all listed fonts embedded.
proof_or_checker: All-page layout inspection; pdffonts; retained historical PDF/source/log byte binding
figure_or_table: All manuscript pages, tables, and figures
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: No clipped text, overlapping table/figure or citation-layout issue was observed. Layout inspection is not independent peer review, scientific/source interpretation, fulltext certification or CSUR certification. No source-version body-read status is upgraded.

claim: Ten complete retrieved PDFs have 70 supplementary located coding-field bindings out of 679 possible fields.
fresh_recheck_and_boundary: Bindings and page bounds are structural checks; 87 records lack this supplementary recoding. Eight transitions preserve historical rechecks. AI-assisted interpretation is not independently verified by software.
